verdict: Paid leads surged this week; overdue build-out milestones remain the priority.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 101 leads from Meta at a cost of $13.30 per lead — and in the most recent 7-day window, lead volume jumped 87.5% while cost per lead dropped 44% compared to the prior 7 days, a meaningful efficiency gain. That performance is running almost entirely through one active campaign, so expanding the channel mix remains important. Ten planned program milestones — covering search campaigns, lead nurturing, local listings, and attribution setup — remain undelivered, some more than 87 days past their original dates; completing these is the single biggest lever for sustaining and diversifying your results. We are working through those milestones now, and you should expect additional channels and tracking to come online in the near term.
